    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for node in seg['nodes']:

            boundary = node['boundary']
            if boundary:
                r0 = boundary[0][0]
                if 50 <= r0 <= 58 and boundary[0][1] == 15:
                    pos0_states.append(node['hash'][:8])
                    break

print("Position 0 states:", pos0_states)

# Get top grid hashes
top_hashes = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B':
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 4 <= r0 <= 30 and 5 <= node['pixels'] <= 15:
                top_hashes.append(node['hash'][:8])
top_set = set(top_hashes)

# Check which pos0 states match top grid
matches = [h for h in pos0_states if h in top_set]
print("Pos0 states matching top grid:", matches)

# Also check blue bar hashes
